recipe_pr.body:
## Problem and behavior

The original Nanaware lymph/DC source preserves quantitative cells but lacked a reproducible training endpoint. Add `nanaware2024_observed_composition_v1` through the registered recipe API: select representative source features before intensity, preserve chemistry and parent ambiguity, connect all source dependencies before deterministic splits, and emit within-parent/sample log-area targets and area fractions with every exclusion.

Original same-study identification alternatives remain candidate parents. Exact sequence occurrences supersede inconsistent reported coordinates for derived positions, without rewriting the source. Missing measurements are never negatives; DC database/library searches remain dependent and human lymph remains extracellular. The older source-only manifest stays unchanged; registered recipe discovery reflects the new consumer capability. Version2.0.28.

## Validation

- Required format/lint and full local test runner: **3,477 passed**; focused recipe/source tests:19passed.
- Actual pinned source:32,995quantity cells and2,472admitted feature measurements independently reconstructed from original areas, original-reference-backed candidates, all-source graph and target arithmetic.
- Prespecified pilot component support: human34/14/12train/validation/test; DCdatabase36/1/6 andDClibrary32/3/11fail validation support, so neither DC cohort is fitted.
- Downstream human modeling does not pass predictive gates; source admission is not a biological accuracy claim. Frozen specification, tests and review notes are included. Rebased onto merged source9133736d without changing the tested source tree.

Follow-up to #817 and merged #818. This does not close unresolved acquisition/specimen/precursor and quantitative aggregation metadata needs.

source_issue_comment.body:
The canonical endpoint is now in [PR819](https://github.com/pirl-unc/hitlist/pull/819), following merged source PR818. It retains source-feature selection, chemistry, all original parent alternatives, excluded-row dependency bridges and sample/source lineage. Independent replay reconciles all32,995quantity cells and2,472derived representative-feature measurements; required local tests pass3,477cases.

This reveals concrete downstream limits:

- A representative confidence-selected charge feature is measurable, but the exports do not establish a safely summed, total peptide quantity. We still need documentation of PEAKS area integration, feature/charge aggregation, normalization and algorithm-specific identification confidence/FDR.
- Complete original search-FASTA/accession/isoform relationships would resolve more parent origins. Current original deposited alternatives are preserved; ambiguous or unsupported sequences are not replaced by a modern reference.
- Exported DC channels still lack exact specimen/acquisition/precursor joins. Database and library outputs share acquisitions. Under the frozen all-source component split, database has36/1/6train/validation/test components and library32/3/11; both fail the predeclared five-component validation minimum, so no DC prediction result is claimed. These counts are not numbers of biological specimens.

Human native lymph passes support with34/14/12components and668positive features. The completed local model comparison **fails** its predictive gates: processing+frozen MS testRMSE0.48463 versus0.46704sequence ridge and0.47913calibrated MS. Exact reverse-KL and fresh REINFORCE64 are close but both worse than uniform. This is an extracellular conditional-signal endpoint, not free APC concentration. Full report/checkpoints/predictions are in Presto experiment `2026-10-24_1938_codex_lymph-composition` on PR131; independent inference reproduces14,028predictions within9.6e-13.

Please retain this issue for the unresolved quantitative grain, original references and sample/precursor metadata; the source and recipe PRs do not resolve them by inference.
